subject: ML Leaders Dinner @NeurIPS'25
text:
Hi [NAME], 

I noticed you're attending NeurIPS this year, so I wanted to extend an invite from our founders [SENDER] & [SENDER] . They're hosting a small dinner for Heads of ML/ Applied Research attending the San [SENDER] conference on Tuesday (12/2). We'd love to see you there! 

We've reserved a private room at Herb & Wood from 6:30pm, with guests joining from Woven (Toyota), Qualcomm, Zipline and more. We're capping the attendance at 20 to ensure engaging discussions. 

For context: Encord helps 200+ AI teams improve data quality at scale. We unify curation, model-assisted annotations and human review in one platform, with the goals of accelerating training dataset preparation. 

Would you be interested in joining us in San [SENDER] on the 2nd?

subject: Automating Annotation Tasks
text:
Hi [NAME],

Given that you are scaling up your perception team to automate annotation,
I thought this could be a good time to reach out. We're working with
companies like Nexar, Motive, and Woven (Toyota), who also train their
models using data from vehicle-mounted cameras, much like your setup.

One of the key challenges these teams face is speeding up iterations when
developing new model features. We address this by streamlining data
curation and annotation workflows - allowing teams to identify rare events,
use models for autolabeling, and pass data through human review for quality
control, all in a single platform.

How are you approaching the data flow at Hayden? I'm available Thursday
morning if you'd like to discuss.

subject: Catch up - automator efficiency
text:
Hi [NAME],

I understand you're familiar with Encord from the past. It seems like your
team is focusing automating annotation so I want to reconnect. You might
find our recent projects with Nexar, Motive and Woven (Toyota) interesting
as they train their models from vehicle camera data.

Our recent work has been helping them improve productivity of annotation
workforce (can be internal or managed by us). We've built out the platform
to orchestrate autolabelling and human review/ label QA process in one
place - helping reduce need of manual annotation and improve label quality.

How's your thinking around training data evolved since? I'm free Fri to Wed
afternoon if you're open to a catch up.

subject: Coffee @RSNA [YEAR]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Given your focus on medical imaging, expect you'll be at RSNA in two weeks? I saw you were at Brainomix previously - we actually work closely with Zoe & Pau there, helping them improve DICOM/NIfTI annotation quality - would love to connect over a coffee at the conference.

A key problem we solve with medical AI teams (Flatiron Health, Viz.ai and Highmark Health, etc.) is to coordinate multi-reader annotation and QC across ML engineers and clinical experts. We address this with built-in consensus/adjudication workflows, structured review stages, and role-based access controls. Our hierarchical ontology builder ensures consistent, context-rich labelling across studies.

Would be great to exchange perspectives over a coffee. We'll be at RSNA Sunday (11/30) to Tuesday (12/2) - how's your schedule looking Monday afternoon?
